title: BMW M2
author: Manuel Contento

configuration.name: BMW M2 Coupé
configuration.variant: Original M2 / N55, pre-LCI exterior; not M2 Competition
configuration.modelYearSelection: 2016–2017 exterior is the best fit. Exact trim and gearbox are not encoded in the creator's title.
identityEvidence: Public creator preview directly inspected: separated chrome kidney grilles, circular xenon-style corona rings, original M2 front bumper, original-style wheels and blue brake calipers.
Compared with BMW's official 2016 M2 photograph; matching body and front fascia.
Model published 2018-02-12, before BMW's 2018-04 M2 Competition announcement; Competition has enlarged black kidney grilles and revised front apron.
configuration.visualCaveat: Community F87 exterior; source shape and smooth normals retained. Body stripes detached as a 3D material edit. Paint RGB and shader properties are display approximations. Front wheels rigidly aligned from their original parked steering pose.

creationEvidence: Creator describes it as a high-poly model made in free time to practice modeling, modeled in Autodesk Maya and textured in Substance Painter.
usage: Ordinary deterministic mesh conversion and game rendering.

download.method: Normal signed-in Sketchfab Download 3D Model → GLB 1k. Geometry matches the separately downloaded 4k GLB; the original download, not the previously simplified mirror, is used.

changes: Replaced the previously simplified public mirror with the creator’s normally downloaded Sketchfab GLB, preserving embedded CC BY attribution.

Applied original node transforms and reflected [world +Z, -X, +Y] into runtime forward/up/screen-right coordinates, with matching normal/winding correction. Uniformly scaled to 4.468m length and tire ground zero. Front and rear M2 badge positions follow the original model and BMW reference.

Preserved all 199,724 original painted-body triangles and source normals in the main model. Other components use Meshopt topology-, normal- and UV-aware simplification; fallback uses the same method and protected body borders. No sloppy spatial clustering.
Removed body stripes with a remappable paint-only material while retaining BMW roundels, lamps, glass, grille and all original detail texture bytes.

Rigidly neutralized the source 18.5 degree front-wheel steering, including hub badges and brake assemblies. Split four rolling wheel groups and kept brake calipers stationary, using their distinct source UV islands.
Embedded only the six unedited 1k base-color images from the normal download; omitted unused normal/roughness maps under the renderer contract.
Paint names/codes are in vehicle-paints.js; rendered RGB, roughness and clearcoat are explicitly approximate.

visualReferences.role: Official BMW 2016 M2 image for visual comparison only; not a redistributable game asset under the model CC license
